title: Penalties.
bodyText: In addition to any other penalties provided by law, violation of any requirement of this part is an unfair method of competition or unfair or deceptive act or practice under section 431:13-102.
bodyHtml: [§431:10D-605]  Penalties.  In addition to any other penalties provided by law, violation of any requirement of this part is an unfair method of competition or unfair or deceptive act or practice under section 431:13-102. [L 2006, c 71, pt of §1]
